x: Another of our Celtic members, G.Deegan, represented Eire in an international v Luxembourg and Wales early in the season. He won the 3000m steeplechase with 8:57.6 to become the second fastest ever Belgravian.
Twentyone year old Gerry Deegan raced to victory by a 20 second margin in the Irish Cross Country Championships at Ennis, County Clare on February 27th
Gerry Deegan became the fastest ever Belgravian over 3,000 metres at Crystal Palace on May 18th. In the Philips Silver Jubilee Night of Athletics, he placed 7th in 7:59.1.

3000m/5000m No sooner had the season started than we learned of Dave Swain's clearance for membership and the first club record of the season had fallen as Dave had chased home Sydney Maree in Philadelphia on 11 April in the fine time of 13.37.8 to remove Eire International Gerry Deegan from the record books.
